description: This file defines the LeaveParameterObject class within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. It encapsulates parameters for leave requests, including employee details, leave type, date range, comments, and multi-day leave options. It provides methods to set and get these properties with validation and logic to handle different leave scenarios.

classes.name: LeaveParameterObject
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) class that encapsulates parameters for a leave request, supporting both single-day and multi-day leave configurations, with validation and partial day options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the LeaveParameterObject with employee number, leave type, and date range.

methods.name: isMultiDayLeave
methods.description: Determines if the leave spans multiple days by comparing fromDate and toDate.

methods.name: getEmployeeNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number for the leave request.

methods.name: setEmployeeNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number for the leave request.

methods.name: getLeaveType
methods.description: Returns the leave type ID.

methods.name: setLeaveType
methods.description: Sets the leave type ID.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the leave.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the leave.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the leave.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the leave, with validation to ensure it is after the start date.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns an optional comment for the leave.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets an optional comment for the leave.

methods.name: getSingleDayDuration
methods.description: Returns the duration for a single-day leave, throws exception if called for multi-day leave.

methods.name: setSingleDayDuration
methods.description: Sets the duration for a single-day leave.

methods.name: getStartMultiDayDuration
methods.description: Returns the start part of a multi-day leave, with validation on partial options.

methods.name: setStartMultiDayDuration
methods.description: Sets the start part of a multi-day leave, with validation.

methods.name: getEndMultiDayDuration
methods.description: Returns the end part of a multi-day leave, with validation on partial options.

methods.name: setEndMultiDayDuration
methods.description: Sets the end part of a multi-day leave, with validation.

methods.name: getMultiDayPartialOption
methods.description: Returns the partial day option for multi-day leave.

methods.name: setMultiDayPartialOption
methods.description: Sets the partial day option for multi-day leave with validation.

methods.name: checkDurationTypeForMultiDayDuration
methods.description: Validates the type of LeaveDuration for multi-day durations, only allows non-full-day durations.

methods.name: checkMultiDayPartialOption
methods.description: Ensures the partial option is valid for multi-day leaves.
